verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a monitoring platform, its SDKs, CLI and self-hosted edition, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documented opt-out control for Sentry's own telemetry or usage tracking. Self-hosting (sentry-docs-11) is a deployment option, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
